system.description:
You begin to collect Fire release chakra until it transforms into gouts of flame that erupt from your weapon. You spin striking all creatures within range attempting to decapitate them. All creatures of your choice must make a dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, they take your [Weapons damage] + 2d6 Fire damage and are Dazed. On a successful Save you take half damage.

Chain 1: Creatures who failed their save gain a rank of Bleed.

Chain 2: Creatures who failed their save gain a rank of Burned.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage reduced by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the radius of this jutsu by +10 feet.
